items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, musically no. Personally, yes. Like friends, "Oh how are you?" and this and that but musically no.

ctx.x: And you eventually played with each of them?

Well, musically no. Personally, yes. Like friends, "Oh how are you?" and this and that but musically no. I know them from the time period. And they also know me, but we never shared musically, only personally as friends, talking about music and the neighborhood and stuff. Quite interesting.
You never competed with them professionally?
